bioanalytical_method: Indirect competitive ELISA against an anti-LMRAP monoclonal antibody
bioanalytical_quote: This method was based on an indirect competitive ELISA for the LMRAP monoclonal antibody, with high specificity and accurate results.
notes: All six PEPlife2 values verified against Table 2, which reports t1/2beta PER ANIMAL for six rats: 45.237, 29.187, 50.979, 18.256, 27.879, 28.452 h (mean 33.332 +/- 11.189 h). PEPlife2 transcribed each animal as its own record, so this single n=6 experiment contributes six rows while most studies contribute one row per reported mean - an unweighting issue inherent to PEPlife2, not a transcription error. One row carries the typo 'Eliminatoin Half Life' (PEPlife2 ID 5209), which left it classified 'unlabelled' while its five table-mates were 'terminal / beta'; the spelling has been added to the phase regex in subset_in_vivo_half_life.py. Note the reported alpha/Ke column is zero for three of the six animals and the paper states a ONE-compartment model was fitted, so t1/2beta here is the single elimination half-life, not the second phase of a two-phase fit.
